title: The Bishop's Ring
text: The Court's bishop has dropped his ring in the crush of the crowd. It glints at a Scion's feet, gold and garnet, heavy as a seal. Nobody else has noticed. The bishop is shouting for it already, and his guards are looking for someone to blame.

options.label: Return it to him, before his guards find someone to hang for it.

outcomes.text: He thanks you too warmly, and the Court welcomes you as its guests. Being the Court's guests is its own kind of danger.

options.label: The shrewdest pockets it, quick as a thought, while all eyes are elsewhere.

outcomes.text: It is a ring that opens doors, and no one saw it taken.
Someone saw. The guards were looking for someone to blame; now they have one.

options.label: Grind it under your heel, and show the Court what you think of its bishops.

outcomes.text: The Court does not forgive even small rebellions. Its guards come quickly.
